# Norman Handyman Repair

> Handyman & Home Repairs in St. George, UT. Ben handles drywall, paint, tile, installs and the rest of the list around St. George. A thorough, detailed bid, work done as quoted, and great communication by text.

## Services
- Drywall & paint: Walls patched, retextured and painted, ceilings too.
- Tile & stucco: Shower tile replaced, stucco and baseboards repaired.
- Installs: Dog doors, over-the-range microwaves, ceiling fans and lights.
- Rentals & out-of-town owners: Jobs at rentals and homes you can't get to yourself.

## Service area
- St. George

## Questions customers ask
- **How do bids work?** Customers say Ben gives a thorough, detailed bid and does the work as quoted.
- **I live out of town. Can you help?** Yes. One customer 1,000 miles away had Ben fix a front door handle and patch walls at their mom's house.
- **What kinds of installs do you do?** Customers mention dog doors, an over-the-range microwave, ceiling fans and lights.
- **Can I text you?** Yes. A customer said Ben was great to communicate and coordinate with via text.
- **What areas do you serve?** We serve St. George and surrounding Washington County. Not sure if you're in range? Give us a call.
